SELECT oo.id AS outboundOrderId, oo.outbound_no AS outboundNo, COALESCE(s.supplier_name, '') AS supplierName, oo.status, COALESCE(SUM(il.lock_qty), 0) AS totalLockQty, COALESCE(SUM(ol.picked_qty), 0) AS totalPickedQty, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN il.status = 'FORCE_STOLEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 1 AS hasForceStolen, oo.created_at AS createdAt FROM outbound_order oo INNER JOIN inventory_lock il ON il.outbound_order_id = oo.id LEFT JOIN outbound_order_line ol ON ol.id = il.outbound_order_line_id LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.id = oo.supplier_id WHERE 1=1
AND oo.outbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{outboundNo}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM material m WHERE m.id = il.material_id AND m.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{materialCode}, '%') )
AND il.status = #{status}
GROUP BY oo.id, oo.outbound_no, s.supplier_name, oo.status, oo.created_at ORDER BY oo.created_at DESC

SELECT il.id AS lockId, kb.kanban_code AS kanbanCode, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, sl.location_name AS locationName, il.lock_qty AS lockQty, kb.status AS lockStatus, il.outbound_order_line_id AS lineNo FROM inventory_lock il JOIN kanban_board kb ON kb.id = il.kanban_board_id JOIN material m ON m.id = il.material_id LEFT JOIN storage_location sl ON sl.id = kb.location_id WHERE il.outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId} AND il.status = 'LOCKED' ORDER BY il.id ASC

SELECT kb.kanban_code AS kanbanCode, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, il.lock_qty AS qty, COALESCE(oo.outbound_no, '') AS originalOutboundNo, COALESCE(sbo.outbound_no, '') AS stolenByOutboundNo, il.stolen_at AS stolenAt FROM inventory_lock il JOIN kanban_board kb ON kb.id = il.kanban_board_id JOIN material m ON m.id = il.material_id LEFT JOIN outbound_order oo ON oo.id = il.outbound_order_id LEFT JOIN outbound_order sbo ON sbo.id = il.stolen_by_order_id WHERE il.status = 'FORCE_STOLEN'
AND (oo.outbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{outboundNo}, '%') OR sbo.outbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{outboundNo}, '%'))
ORDER BY il.stolen_at DESC

SELECT il.id AS lockId, kb.kanban_code AS kanbanCode, kb.board_qty AS boardQty, kb.status AS kanbanStatus, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, sl.location_name AS locationName, il.lock_qty AS lockQty, il.status AS lockStatus, COALESCE(oo.outbound_no, '') AS outboundNo, oo.id AS outboundOrderId, il.created_at AS createdAt FROM inventory_lock il JOIN kanban_board kb ON kb.id = il.kanban_board_id JOIN material m ON m.id = il.material_id LEFT JOIN storage_location sl ON sl.id = kb.location_id LEFT JOIN outbound_order oo ON oo.id = il.outbound_order_id WHERE 1=1
AND il.status = #{status}
AND m.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
AND oo.outbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{outboundNo}, '%')
ORDER BY il.created_at DESC

SELECT id, outbound_order_id, outbound_order_line_id, kanban_board_id, material_id, lock_qty, status, stolen_by_order_id, stolen_at, unlocked_at, unlocked_by, created_at FROM inventory_lock WHERE kanban_board_id = #{kanbanBoardId} AND status = 'LOCKED' FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, outbound_order_id, outbound_order_line_id, kanban_board_id, material_id, lock_qty, status, stolen_by_order_id, stolen_at, unlocked_at, unlocked_by, created_at FROM inventory_lock WHERE outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId} AND outbound_order_line_id = #{outboundOrderLineId} AND status = 'LOCKED' FOR UPDATE
